Not referenced in this compose file or `.env.example`; since this template does not set it, nothing to change, but note it exists if the operator wants hostname-synced naming.
- `DISABLE_SSH` — new, optional, hub-side: "Add `DISABLE_SSH` option to the hub to skip SSH fallback (#2469)". Same situation — not required, hub-only, not in this compose file (which pins `henrygd/beszel-agent`, not the hub image, for this upgrade).
- An unnamed "environment variable to disable container image update checks (#2371)" is mentioned but not spelled out in the notes — cannot report its exact name; nothing to act on from this template since it isn't referenced here.

- Separately from this image: the compose file also pins `henrygd/beszel` (the hub) at `0.20.0`, a different image from the one in scope here (`henrygd/beszel-agent`). Several entries in these notes are hub-only (`SYNC_SYSTEM_NAMES`, `DISABLE_SSH`, fixes to `beszel-hub.service` restart, alert subscription handling, frontend routing).
